body:
Resolves #6023.

The `incompressible_in_time` test in `test/test_time_stepping.jl` ran 12 cases with Nt ∈ {1, 10, 100} at 32³. This PR shrinks the grid to 16³ and drops the 100-step case since it's not necessary to test.

The divergence after a step does not accumulate, so long integrations add nothing. And the 10-step case checks that it does not accumulate anyway.

Claude estimates pretty good time savings on Buildkite, but will check what we get:

| | CPU (coverage build) | GPU |
|---|---|---|
| before (32³, Nt ∈ {1, 10, 100}) | 1655 s | 53 s |
| after (16³, Nt ∈ {1, 10}) | ≈ 69 s | ≈ 49 s |
| saved | **≈ 26 min (96 %)** | ≈ 4 s |
